Vendored typefaces for the Poddle UI (loaded by ../../ui.css — no network needed).

M PLUS Rounded 1c — weights 400, 500, 700, 800, 900 (latin subset, woff2)
  Copyright 2016 The Rounded M+ Project Authors. SIL Open Font License 1.1 — see OFL-MPLUSRounded1c.txt
  Source: @fontsource/m-plus-rounded-1c v5 (repackaged from Google Fonts).

Nunito — weights 600, 800 (latin subset, woff2). Used ONLY for the ellipsis character (U+2026), because the
  M PLUS ellipsis sits at mid-height, Japanese style. Wired up with unicode-range in ui.css.
  Copyright 2014 The Nunito Project Authors. SIL Open Font License 1.1 — see OFL-Nunito.txt
  Source: @fontsource/nunito v5.
